<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Riptide Mount](/Feats.aspx?ID=5284) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

**Requirements**
You are underwater and adjacent to a creature that is at least one size larger than you, has a swim Speed, and is willing to be your mount.

</column>

---

After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them. You [Mount](/Actions.aspx?ID=2314) the creature and [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400) to issue it an order of your choice.
